translations.web: Pharaoh said to him, “Get away from me! Be careful to see my face no more; for in the day you see my face you shall die!”
translations.bsb: “Depart from me!” Pharaoh said to Moses. “Make sure you never see my face again, for on the day you see my face, you will die.”
translations.kjv: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in that day thou seest my face thou shalt die.
translations.asv: And Pharaoh said unto him, Get thee from me, take heed to thyself, see my face no more; for in the day thou seest my face thou shalt die.
